title.narrative: Building capacities for safeguarding living heritage in new African States Parties to the 2003 Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage.

description.narrative: The project aims to support Sierra Leone and South Africa – the most recent states that joined the 2003 Convention – in creating the conditions for the effective safeguarding of their living heritage. It will strengthen national capacities in both countries on key concepts and community-based approaches for, while also equipping them with knowledge and tools to begin engaging with the Convention’s international cooperation mechanisms, including preparing nominations to its Lists and Register. Tailored to the specific situation and needs in each country, the project will deliver targeted capacity-building activities and develop implementation roadmaps.
